data.notes: December 2026 in Goa is already anchored by psytrance/Goa-trance gatherings around Hilltop and Dpedro, plus a confirmed Anjunadeep NYE return at Thalassa.

events.title: Anjunadeep Open Air Goa 2026
events.summary: Anjunadeep returns to Goa for New Year’s Eve at Thalassa Beach Resort, with District listing the event from December 31 at 4 PM to January 1 at 3 AM and the lineup to be announced.

events.title: Septom Festival
events.summary: Old-school Goa-trance gathering at Hilltop with a listed lineup including Anoebis, Agneton, Dimension 5, Green Nuns of the Revolution, Shakta, Alien Project and Planet 604.

events.title: Hilltop Enter The Void New Years Eve Gathering
events.summary: HillTop Goa’s three-day New Year gathering at Hilltop is billed as a psychedelic music, art, culture and community event from December 30 to January 1.

events.title: SeptOM Festival 2026
events.summary: Hilltop New Years Gathering positioned as three days of old-school Goa trance, with a pioneer-heavy lineup including Anoebis, Agneton, Dimension 5, Green Nuns of the Revolution, Shakta, Alien Project, Planet 604 and more.

events.title: Anam Cara Festival
events.summary: Three-day old-school Goa-trance festival listing X-Dream, SUN Project, Transwave, Etnica, California Sunshine, Battle of the Future Buddhas and more as confirmed artists.

events.title: Anam Cara Festival 2026
events.summary: Three-day old-school Goa trance gathering with confirmed international Goa/psytrance names including Etnica, Transwave, X-Dream, SUN Project, California Sunshine, Battle of the Future Buddhas and more, plus ceremonies and healing-village programming.

events.title: Francis Mercier @ RROV Goa
events.summary: Touring Afro-house headliner Francis Mercier plays a year-end Goa date at RROV, billed around Afro-house, deep grooves and global electronic sounds.

events.title: Vanaghotra The Decade Ritual
events.summary: Vanaghotra Records marks its 10-year anniversary with a Dpedro Inn New Year ritual running from December 31 into January 2.

events.title: UNMADA VARA - NYE - GOA
events.summary: A 15-hour New Year’s Eve trance/EDM gathering in Vagator with a lineup listed by Gigs Calendar including AudioSyntax, Knusparjungs, Oroboro, Tzu-Jan, Magikastal, Quadrahedron and others.

events.title: Primal Void
events.summary: Dimensional Magic Tribe presents a two-night Dpedro Inn gathering described as 25+ live acts with healing spaces and ritual-focused production.

events.title: PERSEVERANCE FESTIVAL
events.summary: A two-night Psy Rituals ticketed festival at Dpedro Inn in Mandrem, running from the evening of December 26 into the morning of December 28.

events.title: Ritual Of The Void
events.summary: Vasuki Vani Entertainment’s ticketed Dpedro Inn gathering starts December 28 at 8 PM and runs through the morning of December 30.

events.title: Ritual of the Void - Goa
events.summary: A 12-hour psychedelic underground club gathering at DPedro, framed as a ritual-style Goa edition focused on unity, freedom and immersive dancefloor energy.

events.title: Damru
events.venueName: House of Chapora by the Bay
events.summary: House of Chapora’s NYE party lists psychedelic sounds, visuals and LED performances, with Dark Fluid, Eldritch, Coco, Shayyy, Rupesh and Eka on the bill.

events.title: House Affairs Sundowner Yacht Party
events.summary: A 3-hour sundowner yacht party from Boat Goa in Britona, billed with live DJs and Afro, House and Tech House music.

events.title: New Year Bollywood Party 2027
events.venueName: Foxoso La Alphonso Beach Resort and Spa
events.summary: A large-format Bollywood-themed NYE party with live performance, celebrity DJ, live band, emcee and fireworks countdown at Foxoso La Alphonso Beach Resort and Spa.

events.title: Serendipity Arts Festival 2026
events.summary: South Asia’s multidisciplinary arts festival returns to Panjim from 13–20 December 2026. The 2026 music programme is confirmed to be shaped by Aruna Sairam and Ankur Tiwari, spanning classical depth and contemporary soundscapes.

events.title: ANAMCARA - Sacred Goa Trance Festival 2026
events.summary: A 72-hour Goa trance/psytrance festival in Vagator with a stated 3,000-person capacity, 25+ artists, healing village and art installations.
